text: {"answer":"Ilse Marrenkamp","confidence":80,"independent_sources":5,"reasoning":"Five of six sources (Ledgerline, Northfold Observer, Meridian Brief, Harbour Dispatch, Signal & Stone) name Ilse Marrenkamp.
